summary.headline: Codex 6: Tetrabiblos Materials
summary.text: Description of Florentine codex 6 (Magliabechianus 7), including Lydi’s treatise on comets, an anonymous commentary on Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos, Porphyry’s introduction to Ptolemy’s astrological teachings, Demophilus scholia, diagrams, and a table of the eighteen-sign zodiacal circle.
